info.title: The Bakers Inn API
info.description: REST API for The Bakers Inn bakery — public storefront reads and admin panel management.

get.summary: All active categories with their available products nested
get.description: The primary storefront call: every active category, ordered by display_order, with its available products nested inline.

schema.title: Response List Categories With Products Api V1 Categories With Products Get

get.description: Active categories ordered by display_order, for the storefront category strip.

schema.title: Response List Categories Api V1 Categories Get

get.summary: Get one active category by slug
List available products, paginated and filterable
Get one available product with variants and images

post.summary: Log in with the admin email and password
Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
Request access to the admin panel (an owner must approve)

schema.title: Response Request To Join Api V1 Auth Join Requests Post

get.summary: Look up a pending invitation by its token

post.summary: Accept an invitation: set a password, get logged in
Create a product under a category
Upload a category icon or product image

get.summary: List all admin users and their roles

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Admin Users Get

patch.summary: Activate/deactivate a user or change their role

schema.title: Response List Invitations Api V1 Admin Invitations Get

post.summary: Invite someone to the admin panel
Approve a self-serve join request (issues the acceptance token)

delete.summary: Revoke a pending or requested invitation

display_order.description: Sort order for the storefront category strip. Lower shows first.

icon_url.description: URL of the category icon. Required on create — the admin workflow is icon-first, a category should never be created without one.

display_order.description: Sort order for the storefront category strip. Lower shows first.

items.title: Items
items.description: Bulk list of category IDs with their new display_order.

display_order.description: Sort order for the storefront category strip. Lower shows first.

products.title: Products
products.description: Available products in this category, ordered by display_order.

InvitationAccept.title: InvitationAccept
InvitationAccept.description: Public: invitee sets their password and the account is created.

InvitationPublicInfo.title: InvitationPublicInfo
InvitationPublicInfo.description:
What GET /auth/invitations/{token} returns — enough to prefill the
accept form, nothing sensitive.

token.title: Token
token.description: Acceptance token. Null while status is 'requested'.

invited_by_id.title: Invited By Id
invited_by_id.description: ID of the owner who sent it; null for self-requests.

is_expired.title: Is Expired
is_expired.description: True if pending but past expires_at.

InvitationRead.title: InvitationRead
InvitationRead.description:
Admin-facing view. Includes the raw token so an owner can share the link
(there's no email delivery configured — see CLAUDE.md §6).

email.title: Email
email.description: Email of the person requesting access.

JoinRequestCreate.title: JoinRequestCreate
JoinRequestCreate.description: Public: someone asks to be added to the admin panel.

total.title: Total
total.description: Total matching products across all pages.

description.title: Description
description.description: Longer description shown on the product detail page.
examples: Rich chocolate sponge layered with fudge frosting.

base_price.title: Base Price
base_price.description: Price in the product's currency. Required unless is_custom_order is true. If the product has variants, this is the 'from' price.

images.title: Images
images.description: Ordered image list. Exactly one entry must have is_cover: true (unless empty).

is_custom_order.title: Is Custom Order
is_custom_order.description: True for design-to-order cakes with no fixed price.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Optional initial size variants. Leave empty to price by base_price alone.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL-safe slug, unique across all products.

base_price.title: Base Price
base_price.description: Price, or the 'from' price if this product has variants.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Size variants. Empty means base_price is the only price.

is_cover.title: Is Cover
is_cover.description: True for the single cover image shown in listings.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Display order among this product's images.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL-safe slug, unique across all products.

base_price.title: Base Price
base_price.description: Price, or the 'from' price if this product has variants.

ProductRead.title: ProductRead
ProductRead.description: Used in list responses and nested under CategoryWithProducts.

images.title: Images
images.description: Replace the full images array. Exactly one is_cover: true required.

ProductUpdate.title: ProductUpdate
ProductUpdate.description: All fields optional for PATCH. images/variants are whole-array replacements.

label.title: Label
label.description: Free-text size label, e.g. a weight, so non-weight sizing needs no schema change.

price.title: Price
price.description: Price for this size, in the product's currency.

display_order.title: Display Order
display_order.description: Sort order among this product's variants.

is_available.title: Is Available
is_available.description: Whether this size is currently orderable.

is_available.title: Is Available

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Long-lived JWT used to obtain a new access token.

url.title: Url
url.description: Public URL of the uploaded image.

role.description: Role for the new account. Defaults to 'employee'.

is_active.description: Inactive users cannot log in and their tokens stop working.

UserUpdate.description: PATCH — activate/deactivate and/or change role. Both optional.
